module_summary: AXI-stream frame length adjuster: a 4-state FSM (idle/transfer/pad/truncate) uses min/max down-counters and a frame pointer to zero-pad short frames and truncate long ones, with a skid-buffered output and a status valid/ready report per frame.

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: IDLE/TRANSFER/PAD/TRUNCATE controller selecting pass-through, zero padding or dropping.

anchors.name: short_counter_reg
anchors.why: Bytes remaining to reach length_min; decides padding and pad end.

anchors.name: long_counter_reg
anchors.why: Bytes remaining before length_max; triggers truncation and final tkeep.

anchors.name: frame_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Running frame byte count giving original and output frame length.

anchors.name: last_word_data_reg
anchors.why: Last kept word held during truncation; representative of last_word_* registers.

anchors.name: store_last_word
anchors.why: Load enable capturing last_word_* registers before pad or truncate.

anchors.name: word_cnt
anchors.why: Valid words in current beat from tkeep; compared with counters.

anchors.name: s_axis_tdata_masked
anchors.why: Input data with tkeep-disabled lanes zeroed, forwarded to output.

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata_int
anchors.why: FSM-selected output data: input, zero pad or held last word.

anchors.name: m_axis_tkeep_int
anchors.why: Output keep mask trimmed to min/max length boundary.

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid_int
anchors.why: Internal valid from FSM into the output skid buffer.

anchors.name: m_axis_tready_int_reg
anchors.why: Registered internal ready advancing padding and output transfers.

anchors.name: temp_m_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Skid buffer temp data held while output is stalled.

anchors.name: temp_m_axis_tvalid_reg
anchors.why: Skid temp occupied flag affecting early ready and temp-to-output.

anchors.name: store_axis_int_to_output
anchors.why: Loads output registers from internal datapath.

anchors.name: store_axis_int_to_temp
anchors.why: Loads skid temp registers when output stalls.

anchors.name: store_axis_temp_to_output
anchors.why: Moves temp registers into output registers.

anchors.name: s_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Input frame data, masked and forwarded.

anchors.name: s_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Input valid; with ready advances counters and FSM.

anchors.name: s_axis_tready
anchors.why: Input ready from s_axis_tready_reg; dropped during padding.

anchors.name: s_axis_tlast
anchors.why: End of input frame deciding pad, truncate or status report.

anchors.name: s_axis_tkeep
anchors.why: Input byte enables used for masking and word count.

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Adjusted output frame data from output register.

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output valid from m_axis_tvalid_reg.

anchors.name: m_axis_tready
anchors.why: Downstream ready steering output/temp register transfers.

anchors.name: m_axis_tlast
anchors.why: Output end-of-frame including after padding.

anchors.name: status_valid
anchors.why: Per-frame status report valid, held until status_ready.

anchors.name: status_ready
anchors.why: Status consumer ready; clears status_valid and gates new frame acceptance.

anchors.name: status_frame_pad
anchors.why: Reports that the frame was padded.

anchors.name: status_frame_truncate
anchors.why: Reports that the frame was truncated.

anchors.name: status_frame_length
anchors.why: Output frame length reported on status interface.

anchors.name: length_min
anchors.why: Minimum frame length loaded into short_counter.

anchors.name: length_max
anchors.why: Maximum frame length loaded into long_counter.

groups.name: length_fsm
groups.description: Idle/transfer/pad/truncate controller driving datapath and status.

groups.name: length_counters
groups.description: Min/max remaining-length counters and frame pointer.

groups.name: frame_datapath
groups.description: Input masking, pad/truncate data selection and last-word holding registers.

groups.name: output_skid_buffer
groups.description: Output and temp registers forming an AXI-stream skid buffer.

groups.name: status_report
groups.description: Registered per-frame status with pad/truncate flags and lengths.
